data_note: Real NASA SMAP/MSL telemetry values; seq/HMAC metadata and attacks are injected and labelled. RF and orbit evidence are not available for this dataset.
confidence_reason: one independent source (telemetry): HMAC failures and anomalous values

evidence.sql:
SELECT sat_id, ts, seq, prev_seq, first_seen_ts
FROM (
  SELECT sat_id, ts, seq,
         LAG(seq) OVER (PARTITION BY sat_id ORDER BY CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS prev_seq,
         MIN(CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (PARTITION BY sat_id, seq) AS first_seen_ts
  FROM SATSENTINEL.telemetry_real
  WHERE sat_id = 'SAT-04'
) t
WHERE seq <= prev_seq
  AND CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-01 20:21:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-01 20:29:00' AS TIMESTAMP)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM SATSENTINEL.telemetry_real
WHERE sat_id = 'SAT-04'
  AND hmac_valid = 0
  AND CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-01 20:21:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-01 20:29:00' AS TIMESTAMP)

evidence.summary: real telemetry value: max |z|=3.252 vs own-channel baseline outside window 2026-10-01 20:21:00 .. 2026-10-01 20:29:00; anomalous=True (threshold 3.0)
evidence.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
       MAX(ABS(t.value - s.b_avg)) / NULLIF(MAX(s.b_std), 0) AS max_z,
       MAX(s.b_avg) AS b_avg, MAX(s.b_std) AS b_std
FROM SATSENTINEL.telemetry_real t
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(value) AS b_avg, STDDEV_SAMP(value) AS b_std
  FROM SATSENTINEL.telemetry_real
  WHERE sat_id = 'SAT-04'
    AND NOT (CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-01 20:21:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-01 20:29:00' AS TIMESTAMP))
) s
WHERE t.sat_id = 'SAT-04'
  AND CAST(t.ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-01 20:21:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-01 20:29:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
